{{SupportPage|vendor=NETGEAR|model=WG311T|vs_id=2567}}, [http://support.netgear.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/747 Driver] This device is clearly a [[Cameo WLG-1202|'''Cameo''' WLG-1202]]. "NETGEAR" and "32-bit Wireless PCI Adapter Rev.A3" (as well as a large bit of FCC compliance text, some other stuff, the FCC ID, and the IC ID) is silkscreened on the board. A label on the back of the board identifies the device as a WG311T V1H4 (though it seems this device can also have a label identifying it as an WG311T V1H3 [http://www.netgear-forum.com/forum/index.php?showtopic=41251]). [http://forum.ubuntuusers.de/topic/w-lan-verbindung-funktioniert-nach-einigen-sek/#post-3755992 PCI ID and OUI in this ubuntuusers.de thread] (presumably this device due to the 'AR2414 chip' ath5k message)
